what: Claude Code: a PreToolUse hook for Bash (agent_run.py --guard-hook) goes into the per-run settings, also without the permission relay, and into a settings file of every Claude Code job (agent_job.py, job folder run-settings.json, guard only; 2.615.0 E), and refuses force-push (git push -f / --force / --force-with-lease / --mirror / +refspec), deleting remote refs (push --delete / :ref), deleting or moving tags (git tag -d / -f, update-ref on refs/tags), docker / podman ... prune and reboot / shutdown / poweroff (systemctl reboot ...), whatever the allow list and the permission mode say; git aliases / remote.*.push settings that turn into one of these; it reads the command like a shell (quotes, chains, $( ) / backticks as one word of the outer command and checked on their own, sh -c, eval, ssh, sudo / env / timeout in front with their option values, heredocs fed to a shell; the words of echo / grep / sed / awk ... and git -m / -am messages are text unless fed to a shell; over 256 KB only a name check) and answers deny with a reason the agent reads; a failure of the check itself refuses only a command that names a guarded one; KALMIDO_BLOCK_DANGEROUS=0 switches it off
